q: What share of voters normally vote at elections to the Folketing?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 and November 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvor stor en andel af vælgerne stemmer normalt ved valg til Folketinget?

learn.text: The Danish election system normally requires a party to get at least two percent of the valid votes cast to get into the Folketing.

q: How many percent of the votes at a general election must a party normally get to enter the Folketing?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 and November 2024 exams.

da.q: Hvor mange procent af stemmerne ved et folketingsvalg skal et parti normalt have for at komme i Folketinget?

learn.text: The Danish election system normally requires a party to get at least two percent of the valid votes cast to get into the Folketing.

q: How often must there be a general election according to the constitution?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvor ofte skal der ifølge grundloven være folketingsvalg i Danmark?

learn.text: A general election must be held at least every four years. This is in the constitution.
